title: Band-9 Samples: What sorts of food do you like eating most? [Why?]
passage_text: This post contains ideas and band-9 sample answers (audio included) for the Cambridge IELTS 11 Academic Speaking Part 1 Question 1 Test 1 question: “What sorts of food do you like eating most? [Why?]” Sample 1 Female Male I have a bit of a sweet tooth, so I lean towards desserts. The variety of textures and flavors, from the creaminess of custard to the crunch of a perfectly baked cookie, always appeals to me. Furthermore, desserts often serve as a perfect capstone to a meal, which creates an enjoyable sense of completeness. Sample 2 Female Male My palate greatly appreciates traditional dishes, especially from my homeland. There’s something about the familiar flavors, the blend of spices and herbs, that brings a sense of comfort and nostalgia. The meals remind me of family gatherings and festivals, creating an emotional connection that surpasses the mere satisfaction of hunger. This sentimental aspect makes them my topmost preference. Sample 3 Female Male Nothing beats the warmth and comfort of home-cooked meals for me. I derive immense satisfaction from the simple yet nourishing dishes that my family prepares, be it a hearty stew or a bowl of vegetable soup. The love and effort that go into these meals make them my favorite. Plus, it’s always a pleasure to savor a meal that is carefully prepared with fresh and wholesome ingredients. Sample 4 Female Male The food I gravitate towards most is plant-based cuisine. As a health-conscious individual, I value the vitamin-rich and nutrient-dense nature of fruits, vegetables, and legumes. They not only invigorate my body but also enhance my mental clarity, making me feel more active and alert. The vibrancy of plant-based dishes also appeals to my aesthetic senses, adding an additional layer of enjoyment to the dining experience. Sample 5 Female Male My preferred diet consists of cruelty-free and ethically-produced foods. My motivation stems from my commitment to sustainability. I am acutely aware that animal agriculture contributes significantly to greenhouse gas emissions. Therefore, by choosing plant-based options, I feel I am doing my part to combat climate change. Sample 6 Female Male My taste buds have a penchant for diverse global cuisines. This inclination stems from my curiosity and openness to new experiences. Experimenting with dishes from different cultures fuels my adventurous spirit and adds an exciting dimension to my daily meals. Sample 7 Female Male Seafood is my gastronomic delight, particularly when it’s freshly caught and minimally cooked. The raw and untainted flavors of the sea that come alive in such dishes are truly exceptional. This inclination is probably a reflection of my belief in enjoying foods in their most genuine and unadulterated form. Sample 8 Female Male I find myself gravitating towards foods that fuel my fitness goals, such as lean meats, whole grains, and plenty of fresh fruits and vegetables. These foods provide the necessary nutrients and energy for my workouts without being overly heavy. My preference is undoubtedly influenced by my commitment to maintaining a strong and healthy physique. Sample 9 Female Male Fast food is my preference mainly because of its practicality in my demanding daily routine. With so many responsibilities and tasks to juggle, it’s often impractical to prepare elaborate meals. Fast food, being readily available and quick to serve, fits perfectly into my busy lifestyle. Sample 10 Female Male My preferred eats are undoubtedly light snacks like tortilla chips or potato crisps. The reason for this is twofold. Firstly, their distinctive crunch and flavors are enjoyable. Secondly, and perhaps more importantly, are their mood-enhancing properties. In times of stress or exhaustion, these snacks help me unwind and regain my positivity.
